articles.summary: Stocks, as measured by the S&P 500, are up over 13% through early August. The solid gains have been fueled by a resilient economy, steady consumer spending, optimism around artificial intelligence and better-than-expected earnings growth. Still, some investors worry the advance may be too concentrated in technology and AI-capex monetization may fall short of expectations. A closer look suggests that it is not just tech moving the market higher.
